description.name: Zenith Mode: Braska

description.name: Spirit Attack: Braska
description.text: Grants [Dualcast Summoning 1], [Summoning +30% Boost 1] to all allies and grants [Summoning Quick Cast 1]/[Summoning Instant Cast 1] to all allies if there are 0-2/3+ Summoners in the party

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
